study: Repeated timing of the prospective training-only default
simulation_regime: many_levels: 30 by 24 crossed factors, two replicates, eight fixed-effect candidates; same data generation as accuracy_v2/fresh
initialization: Every method uses max(var(training_y),1e-5)*(0.5,0.25,0.25), separately for each fold. No full-data fit is computed.
canonical_run: Untimed run of every method before randomized timing repetitions, with raw outputs and adaptive traces retained.
random_order: NumPy default_rng(seed+700000); one fresh permutation of all methods per repetition. lexdec seeds 88001 and 88002.
timing_scope: Kernel includes fitting, prediction and method-required local tests; total includes shared fold preparation once. No concurrent numerical jobs; one BLAS/OpenMP thread.
comparisons: Report absolute times and comparator/adaptive paired kernel and total-time ratios; strict baseline is the faster median of strict Newton and L-BFGS-B. Keep unresolved local-bound comparisons separate from point choices.
retention: Retain all planned jobs, failed local tests, numerical fallbacks, unresolved comparisons and warning/error records; do not drop unfavorable timing repetitions.
budget_provenance: 12/20 was an engineering choice made before the prior revision-study execution; no separate prior tuning experiment or data-derived optimality claim exists. The previous plan and results were committed together. This new plan is committed before execution.
optional_real_slope_extension: Not part of this timing study. The candidate models and data are held fixed to isolate initialization and budget costs.
